name: The Exorcist
storyline: Blatty, who also produced, and Friedkin, his choice as director, had difficulty casting the film. Their choice of relative unknowns Burstyn, Blair, and Miller, instead of major stars, drew opposition from executives at Warner Bros. Principal photography was also difficult. Many cast and crew were injured, some died, and unusual accidents delayed shooting. Production took twice as long as scheduled and cost almost three times the initial budget; the many mishaps have led to a belief that the film was cursed.
punchfactor: Must seen movie if you love horror movie

name: Gravity
storyline: Dr Ryan Stone, an engineer on her first space mission, and Matt Kowalski, an astronaut on his final expedition, have to survive in space after they are hit by debris while spacewalking.
punchfactor: 'Gravity' is a must-see film due to its stunning visuals, immersive experience, and exploration of human resilience in the face of unimaginable danger, all while offering a realistic depiction of space travel.

name: Behind Her Eyes
storyline: Based on the No1 best selling novel with that shock ending.  Behind Her Eyes follows the entangled lives of single mother Louise and married couple Adele and David. Their story is romantic, thrilling and twisted at the same time, with an ending that is nothing short of shocking.
punchfactor: Every time when you think, the story you understood, it takes a turn and you are left with a question mark. The ending is so shocking that you will be left speechless. You never know what is going to happen next. The story is so gripping that you will not be able to take your eyes off the screen. The characters are so well written that you will feel for them. The acting is top notch and the direction is brilliant. This is a must watch for anyone who loves a good thriller.

name: Kalki
storyline: Kalki 2898 AD is a 2024 Indian Telugu-language epic mythological science-fiction film directed by Nag Ashwin. Set in a post-apocalyptic world in the year 2898 AD, the story follows the last known city of Kasi, ruled by the tyrannical Supreme Yaskin. Amidst this dystopian backdrop, a prophecy foretells the arrival of Kalki, the final avatar of Lord Vishnu, destined to bring hope and salvation. The narrative centers on a group of rebels, including the immortal Ashwatthama, who must protect Sumati, the mother of Kalki, from Yaskin's oppressive regime
punchfactor: I like it but not as per the book as written in 'Kalki Puran'

name: Chaava
storyline: A historical drama based on the life of Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj, the son of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. The news of the death of Shivaji reaches the court of the Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb. His advisers anticipate the collapse of the Maratha resistance, while Aurangzeb, though acknowledging the loss of a formidable enemy, orders a celebration. However, leadership has already passed to Sambhaji, Shivaji's son. Burhanpur, a key Mughal administrative and commercial center, faces a sudden Maratha attack. The defenders, led by Khan Zamaan and unprepared, are overwhelmed by the onslaught. In the midst of battle, Sambhaji falls into a secret chamber when he steps on a trapdoor where he faces a lion which repeatedly attacks him. Overpowering the beast by splitting open its jaws with his bare hands, he gets out of the chamber and is shown to win a duel with Khan Zamaan. The Marathas then seize the Mughal treasury, directly challenging imperial authority.
punchfactor: Chaava delivers an intense, raw portrayal of torment that gave me genuine goosebumps. The scenes of torture are hauntingly impactful, yet I deeply appreciate the directors thoughtful restraint in not showing every detail. This balance allows the narrative to resonate without overwhelming, leaving a lasting impression that lingers well beyond the screen...
